CITY OF SAN JOSE, CALIFORNIA
Property and Code Enforcement
801 NORTH FIRST STREET SAN JOSE, CA 95110
May 23, 1978
Director, Office of Federal Activities (Mail Code A-104)
Environmental Protection Agency
Room 537, West Tower
Waterside Mall S.W.
Washington, D. C. 20460
Dear Sir:
Herein submitted is the City of San Jose's Final Environmental Impact Statement for the Community Development Block Grant (HUD) in conformance with the Environmental Review Procedures of the Federal Register, July 16, 1975, Section 58.17(f).
The final EIS consists of the Draft EIR/EIS, errata, corrections, comments and response to comments that have been received from individuals and agencies.
Copies of the Final Environmental Impact Statement have been sent to the appropriate agencies as listed under the aforementioned Environmental Review procedures.
We request your assistance in the prompt processing of the enclosed documents. If we can be of any help in this matter, please do not hesitate to call on us.
Sincerely,
John Brezzo
Housing Administrator
